manifest_description.message: Control Pi-hole v6 and AdGuard Home, domain rules, scopes, and temporary actions from your browser.

option_about_copy_debug.message: Please paste the following Debug-Information into the issue:

options_headline_additional_info.message: Choose Pi-hole or AdGuard Home, enter its address and credentials, then save the connector explicitly.

options_client_group_load_error.message: Common scopes could not be loaded. Save working DNS connectors first.

options_hide_group_selector_in_popup.message: Hide the scope selector in the popup

options_hide_group_list_actions_in_popup.message: Hide scope-specific allow and block actions in the popup

options_badge_uses_selected_group.message: Determine the toolbar indicator from the selected scope

options_group_pause_time_hint.message: Used by the three orange scope buttons. Minimum: 10 seconds

options_temporary_allow_time_hint.message: Used by the three orange domain buttons for the selected scope. Minimum: 10 seconds

options_reload_after_disable.message: Reload current tab after disabling global or scoped filtering

options_reload_after_white_list.message: Reload current tab after allowing a domain

options_save_error.message: DNS connector settings could not be saved.

options_url_invalid_warning.message: The URL is invalid. (Missing http(s), invalid scheme or empty)

options_disable_list_feature.message: Hide global whitelist and blacklist actions in the popup

popup_global_error.message: Global DNS protection state could not be changed.

popup_global_mixed.message: Configured DNS connectors currently have different protection states.

popup_group_warning.message: The selected scope is paused and restored automatically when the timer expires.

popup_group_error.message: The selected scope could not be changed.

popup_group_mixed.message: This scope currently has different states across the configured DNS connectors.

option_multiple_connections.message: Actions are preflighted across all configured DNS connectors. Partial failures are rolled back where possible and reported per connector.

popup_domain_general_actions.message: Permanent rule for every default scope

options_backup_secrets_excluded.message: Usernames, passwords, application passwords, session identifiers, and running temporary actions are never exported or synchronized.

options_backup_invalid.message: The backup file could not be validated.

options_backup_password_notice.message: Existing credentials are retained for matching backend types and addresses. New connectors require local credentials after import.

options_sync_description.message: Choose categories individually. Sync is off by default and uses the browser provider; Firefox and Chromium accounts do not synchronize with each other.

options_sync_general.message: Sync display, behavior, and context-menu settings

options_sync_addresses.message: Sync backend types and addresses without credentials
